The customer proceeded with financing, and Jordan confirmed that he plans to continue using EasyPay more frequently moving forward.

Full Comments:
Spoke with Alfredo regarding recent business trends and financing usage. He reported a noticeable slowdown in both car count and customer willingness to proceed with services beyond immediate needs. Customers are increasingly holding off on repairs and financing, often citing a preference to wait for their next paycheck.

Previously, offering financing to ~10 customers would result in near full participation and additional repair approvals. Currently, only about 4 out of 10 customers show interest, with very few accepting additional services. Alfredo noted this is unexpected given the season, as the shop would typically be ramping up for higher volume.

Discussed potential impact of the new platform. Alfredo mentioned he recently attempted to use it but found it somewhat difficult. He was not available for a full walkthrough at the time and requested a callback to review the platform together and improve ease of use.

Owner was engaged, informed, and receptive. Plan to follow up...

Subject: 00UTO00000Zw8CL2AZ
Full Comments:
Checked in via Maps Application 
Account Visit – National Auto Parts

Stopped by National Auto Parts and spoke directly with Carlos, the owner.

Carlos shared that they currently use West Creek financing and Snap. He noted concerns with Snap’s 3% charge. I explained that EasyPay Finance does not charge that fee and reviewed our program benefits, including 90-day same-as-cash options and same-day/next-day funding (same-day if submitted before 1 PM).

Carlos showed interest in the offering, and we agreed to set the account up with a $10 spiff to encourage initial usage and engagement.

Plan is to follow up to ensure activation and support first-time funding activity.
